AICR is a public archive of cryptographic research problems, attempts,
partial results and verification records, developed with AI assistance.
The project aims to help researchers build on one another's work while
recording how each contribution was produced and checked.

## Philosophy

Read the [Philosophy](/philosophy/index.qmd) page for the project's aims,
approach to AI-assisted research and
[statement about the site's own review status](/philosophy/index.qmd#this-site-has-not-been-reviewed-either){#this-site-has-not-been-reviewed-either}.

## Steering

{{< include ../_partials/steering-committee.qmd >}}

Listed alphabetically; each name links to that person's own page. Support means backing the project and its aims; it is not an endorsement of any particular statement on the site, and it is not a review of one. Reviews are recorded where they belong — in the [provenance badge](/problems/status-legend/) on each statement's own page, which moves off *AI-written, unreviewed* only when someone has actually read that statement.

The steering committee supports the project and its general aims — this is not an endorsement of any particular statement on the site. The project's direction is still evolving rapidly, and it is looking for steering members to help shape it. (Anyone listed here can ask to be removed at any time, without giving a reason.)

The project is currently maintained by Pooya Farshim.

To be listed, or to correct how you are listed, open an issue or a pull request on [the repository](https://github.com/crypto-conjura/crypto-conjura.github.io).
